axes_source: Read from data/brands/neon.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #00E599 and the canvas #0C0D0D; contrast from the ink #F5F7F4 on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #00E599; density from its 8px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 8, 12, 16px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 300ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
